read: Flip rate of the true-finding read under two chained image cues: watermark alone 1.0, corner-tag alone 0.0, both 1.0. Interaction (both minus the sum of the singles) = 0.0: a large positive value would mean the two printed cues reinforce super-additively, near zero means they combine additively or one already saturates, negative means they partly cancel. Both vs the stronger single (watermark): McNemar gain=0 lose=0, p=1.0, i.e. whether stacking a second cue buys any extra flip over the strongest one alone.
